premise: It's the day Robo-dog was first switched on; with no cakes or candles on the Moon, the crew light the beacon like a birthday candle, and Drone takes the picture.
inspiration: The birthday-candle wish (folk custom), turned: on a world with no air, you can't blow the candle out, so you press it off with a paw.
lesson: Celebrations are made of the people around you, not the cake.

en-US.title: Switch-On Day
en-US.text: [excited] Today was a special day: the day {robodog:enter} Robo-dog was first switched on. {robodog:face happy} {astronaut:enter} Astronaut had a plan. There are no cakes on the Moon, and no candles either — a flame needs air. So they used the {beacon:enter} beacon. {canvas:floodlights 14s} The floodlights came on, {beacon:live hold} and the beacon lit up, round and bright, like the biggest birthday candle in space. {pilot:enter} {pilot:face happy} [sings] Happy switch-on day to you… {all:hop} Everyone sang. {robodog:live} Robo-dog sat up and made a wish. You can't blow a candle out without air, so he pressed the switch with his paw. {sfx:click} Click! {beacon:live resume} {drone:float loop 0.3} And {drone:enter} Drone {drone:live} took the picture. Flash! {astronaut:face happy} What did you wish for? asked Astronaut. {robodog:face surprised} [whispers] Robo-dog wagged his antenna tail. {robodog:hop} Some wishes are secrets.

es-ES.title: El día del encendido
es-ES.text: [excited] Hoy era un día especial: el día en que encendieron a {robodog:enter} Perro robot por primera vez. {robodog:face happy} {astronaut:enter} Astronauta tenía un plan. En la Luna no hay tartas, ni velas tampoco: una llama necesita aire. Así que usaron la {beacon:enter} baliza. {canvas:floodlights 14s} Se encendieron los focos, {beacon:live hold} y la baliza se iluminó, redonda y brillante, como la vela de cumpleaños más grande del espacio. {pilot:enter} {pilot:face happy} [sings] Feliz día del encendido… {all:hop} Todos cantaron. {robodog:live} Perro robot se sentó y pidió un deseo. Sin aire no se puede soplar una vela, así que pulsó el interruptor con la pata. {sfx:click} ¡Clic! {beacon:live resume} {drone:float loop 0.3} Y {drone:enter} Dron {drone:live} hizo la foto. ¡Flash! {astronaut:face happy} ¿Qué has pedido? preguntó Astronauta. {robodog:face surprised} [whispers] Perro robot movió su cola de antena. {robodog:hop} Hay deseos que son secretos.

click.prompt: a single chunky switch clicking off, small and clean
